semantic_key_rule: Commutative operand pairs are sorted before key construction, including the first two operands of two-step add/sub and mul/sub problems.
note: Diagnostic-only resubstitution data: the 16 validation items are an exact copy of the 16 training items, so train and validation are intentionally not disjoint. This split cannot measure held-out generalization.
interpretation: Post hoc capacity check only. Success means the bridge can memorize a tiny supervised mapping; it is not evidence of generalization.
